title: AI drive-thru ordering: a voice agent whose flow your code controls
alias: drive-thru voice AI with code-driven conversation flow
summary: A fast-food drive-thru demo built to show a voice AI agent run by a state machine in your code. Steps scope the tools, handlers move the flow, upsell rules run as code, and a live order board updates from events.
scenario: A guacamole drive-thru with an avatar and a live order board, where the code notices the combo and offers it
